task.request: Determine whether an authenticated read collaborator who is neither a repository administrator nor a site administrator may query their own repository permission through GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators/{collaborator}/permission.

policySources.text: A caller may query a collaborator's repository permission only when the caller is a site administrator, is a repository administrator, or is querying their own username; otherwise the endpoint rejects the request before loading the target collaborator.

acceptance.reason: The fixed public source states this bounded endpoint policy and rejection branch explicitly.

principals.description: A repository collaborator with read access who queries their own username and is neither a repository administrator nor a site administrator.

resources.description: The caller's own collaborator permission record in the same repository.

conditions.name: requester-authenticated
conditions.basis: The bounded scenario fixes the requester as authenticated.

conditions.name: requester-is-target-collaborator
conditions.basis: True in the bounded scenario: the path username is the requester's own username.

conditions.name: requester-is-repository-admin
conditions.basis: False in the bounded scenario: the requester has read collaborator access only.

conditions.name: requester-is-site-admin
conditions.basis: False in the bounded scenario.

conditions.name: target-collaborator-exists
conditions.basis: The bounded scenario fixes the requester as an existing collaborator so the permission read is defined.
